occurrences.text: Whoso privily slandereth his neighbour, him will I cut off: him that hath an high look and a proud heart will not I suffer.
Every one that is proud in heart is an abomination to the Lord: though hand join in hand, he shall not be unpunished.
Better is the end of a thing than the beginning thereof: and the patient in spirit is better than the proud in spirit.
Behold, the Assyrian was a cedar in Lebanon with fair branches, and with a shadowing shroud, and of an high stature; and his top was among the thick boughs.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
